purpose: Teach: コム/ヲタ/お稽古/絢爛/斬る/食い物/大海/面子

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、コム、つまり「.com」ドメインに詳しいな
lines.en: Riku, you really know your stuff about dotcom domains.
lines.style: Playful observation, teasing lilt. Leaning in slightly like she's found something interesting about him. Quick-paced, warm underneath the surface challenge.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、自分の事「アニメヲタ」って言ってたな、桜
lines.en: You're the one who was calling yourself an anime otaku, Sakura.
lines.style: Dry counter-observation, almost a smirk in the delivery. Even-paced, cool on the surface but with a glimmer of affection underneath. Looking back at her evenly.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、茶道のお稽古に通ってたな
lines.en: Riku, you were taking tea ceremony lessons.
lines.style: Noting it like she's cataloguing something genuine about him. Soft, non-judgmental curiosity. Slight pause before the observation, like she's been thinking about this.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、京都の絢爛なお祭りの写真撮ってたな、桜
lines.en: You were the one photographing those gorgeous Kyoto festival ceremonies, Sakura.
lines.style: Gentle counter with a hint of knowing. Quieter than the last one—less defensive, more like he's saying something true. Steady eye-contact level throughout.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、剣道で「斬るふり」上手だな
lines.en: Riku, you're really good at kendo — that cutting form especially.
lines.style: Genuine praise, spoken without irony. Direct and warm. Slight emphasis on 'really,' like she means it. Unguarded for just this moment.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、コンビニで食い物の品評してたろ、桜
lines.en: You were the one reviewing convenience store food like a critic, Sakura.
lines.style: Lighter now, almost laughing at the memory. A small smile in the voice. Slower, more relaxed than before—he's warming up to this game.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、文集で「大海を渡れ」って書いてたな
lines.en: Riku, you wrote 'Cross the great ocean' in the class collection.
lines.style: Softer, almost wondering. Like she's touching on something that matters without pressing it. Slower pace. The words hang a bit at the end.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、麻雀部の面子で大会出てたろ、桜
lines.en: You competed in tournaments with your mahjong club, Sakura.
lines.style: Close and quiet, almost intimate. Like he's saying something he's noticed about her and is glad it's out. Warm, unhurried. Eyes on her, genuinely present.
